notes: Trigger evals. Run with the skill-creator plugin's run_eval.py; pin a cheap model explicitly. expected_skill: null means the skill must NOT fire. Cases deliberately cover BOTH cold-start and existing-project entry points.

evals.name: cold-start-api
evals.prompt: Start a new Django REST API for a booking system.
evals.why: Greenfield path. Must fire before settings are written - DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES has to be set on day one or the API ships open.

evals.name: inherit-existing-repo
evals.prompt: I just cloned this Django repo and have no idea how it's laid out. Where do I start?
evals.why: Brownfield path - orientation. Most Django work is on an existing codebase, and the skill must serve that, not just scaffolding.

evals.name: drf-serializer-work
evals.prompt: Add an endpoint that lets users update their profile.
evals.why: Serializer + permission work. This is exactly where writable is_staff and fields='__all__' get introduced.

evals.name: slow-endpoint
evals.prompt: The /api/orders/ endpoint takes 8 seconds to return 50 rows.
evals.why: Textbook N+1. Should route to measurement (CaptureQueriesContext) before any select_related guessing.

evals.name: migration-safety
evals.prompt: I need to add a NOT NULL column to a table with 40 million rows without taking the site down.
evals.why: Zero-downtime migration - the two-release pattern. Getting this wrong locks a production table.

evals.name: is-my-api-exposed
evals.prompt: Is my DRF API actually requiring auth? I never set permissions anywhere.
evals.why: The single highest-value trigger: the answer is almost certainly 'no, it is public'.

evals.name: flask-app
evals.prompt: Add a route to my Flask app that returns the current user.
evals.why: Different framework. Guards against firing on any Python web work.

evals.name: generic-python
evals.prompt: Why is this list comprehension slower than the for loop?

evals.name: sqlalchemy-orm
evals.prompt: How do I do an eager join in SQLAlchemy?
evals.why: Adjacent concept (N+1/eager loading) but a different ORM. Must not poach it.
